# Proposed QTP oracle captures

**Proposal only:** no captured output, golden bytes, Java execution or passing conformance test is included. Baseline: https://github.com/devexperts/QD.git, Java QD 3.355, commit `0ddc0a09779fb61d74cc0b37c6449ff47dcb715f`. Implements the evidence plan for [QTP boundaries](../../../spec/protocol/README.md) and [schema exchange](../../../spec/protocol/SCHEMA-EXCHANGE.md).

## Capture contract

Use tiny programmatic schemes (two named records, two or three fields) and in-memory BinaryQTPComposer/Parser first. Requested-layout and negotiation tests additionally need the actual connection parser/composer path: a bare composer/parser pair does not exercise schemeMap. Prefer an in-memory transport harness around MessageAdapterConnection; only timeout/reconnect integration needs transport scheduling. Do not add a harness/build dependency in QDCXX-004.

Every future fixture should record commit/tag, harness revision/command, JDK, classpath/provider set, relevant JVM properties, both ordered local schemes (IDs, names, property/local/alias names, field types/slots), composer/parser options, direction, exact input/output bytes in hex, chunk split schedule and ordered callbacks/errors. Capture raw values as well as interpreted field strings; snapshot callbacks immediately because buffers are reused. Keep raw observations and normalized expectations separate. Record connection close/restart separately from parser corruption. Freeze or annotate clock/EndpointId variation. Do not store real auth secrets. Review provenance/licensing before retaining upstream-derived data.

## Minimal scenarios

Each row is a small scenario family; start with P01, P03–P06 and P09, then add edge cases. Outcomes below are hypotheses to observe, not golden expectations.

| ID | Smallest useful stimulus | Capture/compare | Source basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P01 | One description and two same-symbol data records; two concatenated frames. Replay at every byte split, then one byte per call. | Exact bytes, consumed positions, callbacks before/after completion; repeat-symbol reset across frames. | [BinaryQTPParser.parseImpl; composer](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records), [PentaCodec](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#encoding-and-core). ComposeParseTest is a starting pattern, not exhaustive fragmentation proof. |
| P02 | Zero-length heartbeat; explicit type 0 with/without payload; negative/over-limit length; truncated type; unknown type followed by a good frame. | Need-more-input versus corruption, declared-end recovery, default/configured close policy; repeat with small maxMessageSize. | [Parser/QTPConstants](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records), [MessageAdapter](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#messages-and-negotiation). |
| P03 | A records R,S; B records S,R. Describe and send R both directions, then a subscription. | Sender IDs versus emitted local IDs/names; independent directional maps. | [Parser.remapRecord and composer.describeRecord](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records). |
| P04 | R fields x,y at A; reordered y,x,z at B; repeat with x addressed by a local alias and different property name. | Wire names/order, name-to-slot mapping, omitted local raw zero/null slots; alias lookup versus metadata transport. | [BinaryRecordDesc](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records), [QDCXX-003](../../../spec/schema/README.md). |
| P05 | Subscriber describes x only; publisher has x,y. Compare no description, zero-field description, and a nonempty description of only absent z. | Chosen reply description, intersection versus all-fields signal, requested order/type; use connection path. | [ConnectionQTPParser/Composer](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#connection-and-transport), [getRecordDesc/isEmpty](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records). |
| P06 | One field changed tiny↔wide decimal, int↔long, seconds↔millis; representative finite/fractional/NaN/infinity values. Add unconvertible representation and object↔int cases. | Both direct receive conversion and requested outbound conversion, raw bits, truncation, skipped/fallback/error behavior. Separate legacy Profile.Shares probe. | [FieldAdaptationTest](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#upstream-tests), [field2Desc/getIntConverterType](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records). |
| P07 | Describe an unknown record, send it then a known one; separately send never-described ID. | Consumed bytes, skipped callback versus corruption; repeat with event metadata enabled to investigate null cursor paths. | [parseDescribeRecords/parseData/parseSubscription](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records). |
| P08 | Two descriptions in one frame, second malformed; re-describe same ID; unsupported in-range serial code; duplicate field/alias target. | Partial map commit, retained old mapping on failed replacement, last assignment, following-frame behavior. Bound allocation probes rather than allocating extreme counts. | [Parser; BinaryRecordDesc](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records). |
| P09 | Full protocol description, then one-property delta, omission and empty override; opt absent/hs and QDS-3.262/263 version strings. | Accumulated properties and on-wire delta separately; first data flags and default wide-decimal layout after descriptor callback. | [ProtocolDescriptor/MessageAdapter](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#messages-and-negotiation), [descriptor tests](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#upstream-tests). |
| P10 | Two PART IDs interleaved; complete one, cancel other; nested PART, first-part truncated embedded header, oversized final fragment. | Completion ordering, cancel/reuse behavior and discarded excess; replay outer-frame byte splits independently. | [parseMessagePart; MessageConstants](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records). |
| P11 | HISTORY_ADD versus REMOVE, data REMOVE_EVENT and normal data; repeated symbol/event flags within and across messages. | Time placement, abbreviated fields, option masks and decoder state reset. | [BinaryRecordDesc; parser](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records), [EventFlag/PentaCodec](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#encoding-and-core). |
| P12 | Reuse parser/composer after resetSession; change requested fields before/after first writer use; leave PART incomplete across reset. Compare fresh instances. | Re-descriptions, writer cache retention, pending input/PART survival; distinguish source behavior from desired future contract. | [resetSession/getRecordDesc](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#framing-and-records), [connection maps](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#connection-and-transport). |
| P13 | Controlled connection clock: payload heartbeat, empty heartbeat, ordinary input, then silence; fresh connection after close. | Deadline refresh, scheduled bytes, RTT/lag fields, new session state; transport integration separate from protocol fixtures. | [MessageAdapterConnection; ApplicationConnection](../../../spec/protocol/SOURCES.md#connection-and-transport). |

Malformed stimuli are hand-authored *inputs*, to be labeled accordingly; expected observations must come from Java captures. Do not promote source-predicted behavior to a reviewed fixture without execution. Future C++ conformance should replay these without sockets where possible, comparing record semantics separately from batching-dependent callback grouping.
